name: yt-admin
description: Yellowtail Admin, the Yellowtail team's desk plugin for the admin MCP connector: fulfil customers' orders, invite founders, file signals from event notes and announced deals, keep the investor catalog clean, and run the daily research — prospecting new investors for paying customers, enriching the catalog's contact details and scanning investors for signals — on a schedule. Platform admins only; customers use yt (Yellowtail Club).
